article.title: Summer Lights fireworks set for English Bay July 31
article.readerJob: Help Vancouver residents decide whether to attend the free July 31 English Bay fireworks event and plan around access, parking, transit, and crowd rules.
article.lengthRationale: A bulletin is the shortest complete format because readers mainly need the date, location, ticket rule, crowd and transport warnings, and what to check before leaving.
